en: Vintage black‑and‑white street view showing a broad, gently rising avenue lined with late 19th–early 20th century townhouses and villas on both sides. The architecture features steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, bay windows and small turrets typical of German Gründerzeit style. A solitary person walks along the nearly empty street. At the top left in red print appears the caption indicating the town and street name.
